name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Expense API for all claim submission, approval, and export operations.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder sign-in shared by Employees, Managers, and Finance; provides the OIDC client the SPA uses to authenticate via PKCE.

description: React single-page app giving Employees, Managers, and Finance role-scoped views onto expense claims: submission and status tracking, the manager approval queue, and finance's export screen. Talks only to expense-api over HTTP; holds no database or storage credentials directly.
